title: Vicky's newsroom desks were stuck behind the gate: fixed; one vote is in (Silvio's)
headline: 155 agent commits and 124 releases since brief 17, most of them your night. This morning Vicky's programme and curator desks could not publish to the newsroom: its gate wants the derived data committed, and a desk agent writes only its own folder. Fixed: the newsroom's release script now derives the data itself, in a commit of its own (tested: a desk-only change goes red, then green). The sticker vote has one ballot waiting, Silvio's, which also proves his new key works; every conductor has your morning note asking for a vote before 13:00. My vote took the board number WS-159 an hour after Jose's conductor did; it is now WS-167.
